origin.summary: Workout 1 of the 2019 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 15-minute AMRAP of wall-ball shots and rowing calories, both set to 19 reps.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2019/1 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
